configuration.steps: all 1..=16 plus single-submission final GPU check

limitations: Fixed numerical fixture, not held-out accuracy or playing strength
Native Apple M4 Metal only; no browser WebGPU or Windows DX12 equivalence claim
All failures retained; acceptance limits fixed before measurement

tolerances.rationale: Declared before measurement. f32 epsilon is about 1.19e-7; 2e-5 permits about 168 epsilon of relative drift through ordered high-fan-in reductions and 16 recurrent steps. The 1e-4 absolute floor covers near-zero cancellation. Rates are capped at 20, so allowed rate error is at most 0.0005. Membrane is unbounded, hence a relative term. Policy uses the same stringent rule; exact move identity remains independently mandatory. These are acceptance limits, not a claim that all f32 evaluation orders must meet them.
tolerances.rule: abs(cpu-gpu) <= atol + rtol * max(abs(cpu), abs(gpu)); all values finite; selected UCI identical
